title: Automations, Cloud Agents, Bugbot Improvements, Design Mode Updates
description: Cursor introduced the /automate skill for creating automations directly in agent sessions, new GitHub and Slack triggers, cloud environment setup, cloud subagents with /in-cloud, improved handoff between local and cloud, and significant Bugbot performance improvements (3x faster, 22% cheaper, 10% more bugs found). Design Mode received multi-select elements and voice input capabilities.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor appears to be abandoning their original attitude toward AI coding for what seems like a strategic play

title: MCP Support Generally Available in VS Code (v1.102)
description: GitHub Copilot made Model Context Protocol (MCP) support generally available in the June 2025 VS Code release (v1.102), available July 9, 2025. The update also includes an open-sourced Copilot Chat extension and support for Copilot coding agent.

community_feedback.quote: New MCP servers went from 135/month at launch (Nov 2024) to 5,069/month in June 2025
MCP servers are 'always in the context' and run as servers to assist with planning

title: v0.85.0 Release - Responses API Models and Gemini 2.5 Support
description: Aider v0.85.0 released on June 27, 2025, adding support for OpenAI's Responses API models (o1-pro, o3-pro), new Gemini 2.5 Pro models, and updated o3 pricing. The release also includes thinking tokens support and various quality-of-life improvements. Aider wrote 21% of the code in this release.

community_feedback.quote: Aider has the shortest system prompt so it is much snappier
Aider blows Claude Code completely out of the water in actually getting serious work done
Not as easy to use as some alternatives - requires being more hands on

title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet Support and Team Model Controls
description: Windsurf v1.42 (March 17, 2025) added Claude 3.7 Sonnet model support and introduced model selection controls for teams and enterprise plans, allowing admins to select which models are available to team members.

title: Windows VM Support and Improved Feedback Controls
description: Devin expanded to support building, running, and testing natively in Windows VMs, bringing autonomous AI engineering to Windows developer ecosystem. Also introduced improved feedback controls with always-visible thumbs-up/down buttons and enhanced session-level feedback modal.

title: No specific updates in June 2025 timeframe
description: Based on available information, no major updates were specifically documented for Claude Code in the June 2025 timeframe. The product launched as a research preview in February 2025 and continued incremental updates throughout the year.

title: Acquired by Cursor - No Active June 2025 Updates
description: Continue.dev has been acquired by Cursor, and the main website now redirects to information about this acquisition. No specific updates were found for June 2025. The project's final stable release (2.0.0) of the VS Code extension, CLI, and JetBrains plugin occurred prior to the acquisition.
